caption: The drawing features a man seated on a padded bench with scrollwork legs, positioned centrally within a decorative, ornate yellow frame. The man is wearing a brown suit with a white shirt and beige pants, brown shoes, and a black bow tie. He has dark hair and a mustache and holds his chin with one hand, while his other hand rests on his lap. On the left side of the man, there is a red rectangular table with three closed books on top. On the right side, another red rectangular table holds a white sphere and a sheet of paper. The floor has a pattern of reddish-brown tiles arranged diagonally, while the background is a flat blue color. The scene is entirely enclosed in a curved, symmetrical golden frame with ornamental scrollwork on all sides.
title: Sternpiece
